blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Celo block 74313815 (2026-08-08T18:42:53Z), the sole tracked COPm deployment 0x8a567e2ae79ca692bd748ab832081c45de4041ea returned owner() = 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, broker() = 0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad, validators() = 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, and exchange() = zero. Its EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots still resolved to verified StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e and the Mento Timelock. The verified implementation exposes ordinary transfer/transferFrom, permissioned mint, broker/exchange-scoped burn, and Celo-VM-only gas debiting; it has no blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Mento's official materials describe direct protocol distribution and community governance with no single controlling entity, not a separate issuer freeze power. Direct holder freeze is therefore false; reserve-leg censorship and the timelocked upgrade path remain measured upstream and restrictability risks.
